projects.name: MDT Tentative Construction Plan - TCP 2026 LINES
projects.notes: MDT Tentative Construction Plan: projects scheduled for letting in federal fiscal years 2025-2030 (FFY_YEAR is the planned year, integer). All records are planned work; no status field, so future = FFY_YEAR >= current FFY. PROJ_TYPE is a 6-value category (BRIDGE, RECONSTRUCTION, REHABILITATION, RESURFACE, SAFETY, OTHER); SCOPE is a coded description such as '310 - ROADWAY & ROADSIDE SAFETY IMPROVEMENTS'. CN_AND_CE = construction + construction engineering dollars, CN = construction only, COST_RANGE in $ millions. No county field (FN_DISTRICT = MDT district 1-5; ROUTE/BEG_REF_POST/END_REF_POST locate it). PROJECT_ID is the federal project number.
